launcher.notes: 64-bit Java, guaranteed: a 64-bit PC with only a 32-bit Java 8 no longer launches with it (the exact java.lang.OutOfMemoryError from the latest crash report — HotSpot Client VM, 1 GB ceiling). The launcher now downloads the official 64-bit Temurin JRE 8 automatically (one time, ~45 MB) and only falls back to the capped 32-bit JVM if the download fails. The desktop shortcut logo is fixed at every layer: the installer pins the desktop tile icon explicitly, the build byte-verifies the icon inside the exe, and every silent update repairs the desktop shortcut (retarget + explicit icon) before flushing the Windows icon cache. Bundles Client v2.9.20 (AutoGG universal detection).

notes: Client v3.0.0 (KUI release): native Java/OpenGL UI framework - new main menu, world selector, multiplayer, ClickGUI and more; Microsoft account switch fixed; FPS regression fixed (Unlock FPS restored); client cosmetic changes now save to your Kinetrix account. Launcher v2.4.12 incoming - bundles this client for fresh installs.
